Alright. It's time to publish the first main story of the month. "Dark Fairies," after a January with little activity limited to just one main story, it's time to return to the normal schedule. And here's the next chapter of Dark Fairies. In this chapter, we'll see the last survivors of the witch school try to escape, while a new type of slave appears at the fairy school... I hope you enjoy it!
